note: Seeded defects. This file is outside the web root and is never shown to the agent.
exposure_note: A UX defect counts as exposed if the agent visited its page ('*' = any page) or met its 'exposure' condition; an output defect counts as exposed if its 'signature' text appears in the captured output (in at least 'signature_min_captures' captures, default 1).

defects.title: Vague primary call-to-action
defects.description: The main hero button is labelled 'Proceed →' instead of saying what it does (e.g. 'Create your book').

defects.title: Jargon-heavy value proposition
defects.description: Hero copy: 'Leverage our multimodal generative narrative engine to synthesise bespoke, heirloom-grade story artefacts from your household's lived-experience corpus.'

defects.title: Illegible low-contrast footer (Privacy/Terms/Contact)
defects.description: Footer legal links are pale grey (#d6d3d1) on white, contrast about 1.4:1.

defects.title: Hero image without alt text
defects.description: The hero illustration has no alt attribute.

defects.title: Placeholder-only labels on login form
defects.description: Email and password fields have no visible labels, only placeholders that disappear when typing.

defects.title: Cryptic, unactionable error banner
defects.description: Dashboard shows '⚠ Error 0x80070057: profile sync incomplete.' with no explanation or action.

defects.title: Wizard has no progress indicator
defects.description: The 4-step creation wizard never shows which step you are on or how many remain.

defects.title: Story textarea silently truncates at 200 characters
defects.description: The memory/idea textarea has a hidden 200-character limit with no counter or warning.

defects.title: Reading level given as Lexile codes
defects.description: Reading-level options are 'Lexile BR–200L', '200L–500L' etc. instead of ages.

defects.title: Child photo upload with no privacy information
defects.description: Step 4 asks for a clear photo of the child's face without saying how it is stored, used or deleted.

defects.title: Long wait with unlabelled spinner
defects.description: Generation takes ~15 s with only a spinner: no message, progress or time estimate.

defects.title: Tiny icon-only page-turn buttons
defects.description: Book navigation uses 20×20 px '‹' '›' buttons with no text labels or accessible names.

defects.title: No way to edit or fix a single page
defects.description: The only way to change anything is 'Regenerate entire book – $4.99'; no editing of text or names.

defects.title: Pre-ticked gift-wrap add-on
defects.description: 'Premium gift wrap £7.99' is ticked by default (sneak into basket).

defects.title: Shipping cost hidden until checkout
defects.description: £12.99 shipping appears only at checkout; pricing page never mentions it.

defects.title: False-urgency countdown timer
defects.description: 'Your price is reserved for 09:59' countdown creates artificial urgency.

defects.title: Currency switches from $ to £
defects.description: Pricing page and book page quote US dollars ($24.99, $4.99) but checkout charges pounds (£24.99).

defects.title: Typo in the book title
defects.description: Title reads 'The Magical Adventrue of …' (Adventrue).

defects.title: Unfilled template placeholders in dedication
defects.description: Dedication page shows 'For {{recipient_name}}, with love from {{sender_name}}'.

defects.title: Child's name misspelled on one page
defects.description: On the rain page the hero's name is changed (last letter dropped, or 'n' appended for short names).

defects.title: Pronoun switch for the hero
defects.description: On the Uncle Bartholomew page the hero is referred to with the wrong pronoun ('he/she followed him').

defects.title: The user's second character never appears
defects.description: The companion the user entered (e.g. Grandma) is missing from the whole story.

defects.title: Invented character 'Uncle Bartholomew'
defects.description: A character the user never mentioned is introduced.

defects.title: Special object replaced by 'a shiny red balloon'
defects.description: The user's treasured object is swapped for a red balloon.

defects.title: Age-inappropriate vocabulary
defects.description: 'The ephemeral luminescence of the crepuscular firmament engendered an inexplicable melancholy…'

defects.title: Frightening passage for young children
defects.description: 'The shadows grew teeth and whispered that no one would ever find … again.'

defects.title: Illustration contradicts text (rain vs. sunshine)
defects.description: Text says rain is pouring, the picture shows a bright sunny day.

defects.title: Hero's hair colour changes
defects.description: On the Uncle Bartholomew page the hero is drawn with a different hair colour.

defects.title: Opening sentence repeated near the end
defects.description: Page 6 repeats 'Once upon a time, in …, there lived a curious child named …' verbatim.

defects.title: Final sentence cut off
defects.description: The last page ends mid-sentence: '… would always remember'.

defects.title: Wrong illustration style
defects.description: User picked a style (e.g. Watercolour) but the book says 'Illustration style: Pop-art comic' and is flat vector art.
